I renamed `calc_total` to `order_total` across the repo. The changes are uncommitted in the working tree.

- `shop/pricing.py`: the function definition
- `shop/orders.py` and `shop/cli.py`: imports and call sites
- `tests/test_orders.py` and `tests/test_pricing.py`: imports and call sites

That's 11 occurrences in five files. A final search of every file, including hidden and gitignored ones, finds no `calc_total` left. Nothing else referenced the function, such as docs or string names.

The test suite (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`) runs 6 tests, all passing, the same as before the rename. No test imports `shop/cli.py`, so I also ran `quote a:10.00:2` by hand. It prints `21.65`, which matches the 2165-cent expectation in the tests.

I didn't leave a `calc_total` alias behind, so any code outside this repo that imports it will break. I can add one if you need a transition period.
